messages:
Ava Morgan: Quick UX thread 1: compact legend idea for dense metric cards: show current unit + tiny sparkline + a chevron that cycles unit modes (Auto/Raw/Per-1000). Saves vertical space. Thoughts?

Ravi Singh: Compact is good. Concern: cycling could be confusing. Need visible state and keyboard support.

Elena Park: Add a tooltip on hover that lists the cycle order and a caption beneath the control on mobile. For keyboard: Enter cycles, arrow keys toggle preview increments.

Dmitri Volkov: Outlier handling: rather than rescaling, cap and show an overflow chip ">=X" with count. Clicking chip expands a small panel listing top offenders.

Ava Morgan: Good. Also propose a smoothing indicator dot on the sparkline (tiny filled circle) when smoothing is enabled. Provide a short toggle in the legend menu: Smoothing on/off.

Ravi Singh: Implementation note: compute sparklines server-side for large datasets to avoid client lag. Client can cache per-query window.

Elena Park: Accessibility: control should have role=button and aria-label like: "YAxis units: Auto, press Enter to switch to Raw". For the overflow chip, use aria-expanded when the panel is open.

Dmitri Volkov: Microcopy suggestion for overflow: "Values >= 10,000 (12 cells) 1: click to inspect". Keep it short.

Ava Morgan: Decision: move forward with compact unit control + sparkline + overflow chip + smoothing indicator. Action items: Ravi scope server-side sparkline; Elena write aria copy; Dmitri draft microcopy.

Designbot: Added figma frame: https://www.figma.com/file/zzzz1111/compact-legend-sparkline 1:frame: legend/compact-sparkline-v1

Ava Morgan: Thanks f: will update mocks and open design-implement ticket.
